# Causal Tree App

Just want to post a quick update that I deployed a R shiny app on Posit Connect Cloud that allows you to explore data and results for a causal forest method. [App is here!](https://019fdd39-bfb0-20c4-755e-11c1dbda0af6.share.connect.posit.cloud/)

The data currently uploaded to it is a synthetic RRP trial data set but you should be able to upload csv data and run your own analysis. 

I do need to fix the policy tree generation but it should be useful outside of that.
